# Technical annex: packing acceptance criteria

This annex defines the physical checks for reusable display cases. It contains no customer record and no completed personal-details form. The measurements describe objects, while the times describe an inspection timetable. Neither table identifies a person or a private organisation.

| Check | Specified value | Permitted variation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Internal dimensions, millimetres | 202 × 555 × 184 | 2 millimetres |
| Seal width, millimetres | 18.5 | 0.5 millimetres |
| Maximum load | 32 kilograms | No upward variation |
| Surface finish | 80 percent gloss | Five percentage points |

| Inspection activity | Start | Finish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unloaded check | 08:30 | 09:15 |
| Load test | 09:30 | 10:00 |
| Documentation review | 10:15 | 10:45 |

The test fee is GBP 275. A failed dimensional check requires a second measurement with the calibrated gauge; it does not automatically establish a contractual breach. The assessor should record the instrument setting and retain the calculation sheet.

Section 3.4 and article 18 describe the measurement procedure. The proposed inspection date is 4 December 2026. The form headings Person, Organisation, Address, Email, Telephone, Identity and Bank remain empty in the accompanying blank template.

No signature is requested on this technical copy. Acceptance must be recorded on the separate transaction sheet after the physical checks are complete.
